# C_ElegansConnectome

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The complete neural wiring diagram of Caenorhabditis elegans, comprising 302 neurons and their synaptic connections, used as a reference network for computational studies. Serves as a biologically validated, small-scale network model for testing TCC architectures and neuromorphic computing principles with known behavioral correlates.
